justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/compiler/CompilerJava.java, core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/AbstractProcess.java, and sibling compilers CompilerGroovy.java / CompilerJavaScript.java. CompilerJava is only 75 lines with one field, one constructor, and one public compile method; it only resolves the javac path, assembles a command list, and delegates execution to AbstractProcess.runCommands(). This is a small, cohesive wrapper with no evidence of excessive size, many methods, or separable responsibilities.
